title: BUILD 1/16: Romance state + API (new scripts/romance.gd, run['romance'], save migration)
repro: No dating/marriage exists: grep for marri|spouse|bouquet|propos in scripts/data finds nothing. Friendship is run.friendship 0..250 (HEART_POINTS 25, add_friend clamps 250); heart scenes are Hearts (2/4/6/8/10).
fix: New class_name Romance (scripts/romance.gd), static, reading data/romance.json (build 2). State in run['romance'] = {dating:'', dated:{id:day}, dates:{id:n}, engaged:'', engaged_day:0, wedding_day:0, spouse:'', married_day:0, spouse_talk_day:0, ex:{id:day}}. Add the default to BOTH new-run dicts in game_state.gd (~line 95 and ~256) and a guard in GameState._migrate (missing key -> default; never touch friendship). API: candidates() (arc-filtered ids from romance.json), is_candidate(id), status(id) -> ''|'dating'|'engaged'|'spouse'|'ex', can_bouquet(id) (candidate, hearts>=8, not dating/engaged/married anyone, not Npc.is_kid, not Net.visiting()), can_propose(id) (dating id, hearts>=10, dates[id]>=2, House.tier()>=2 via Builds.built_tier('house')>=2, no festival in the next 3 days), give_bouquet/propose/stay_friends, spouse(), is_married(), spouse_name(), wedding_due() (day == wedding_day). Decisions baked in: NO heart cap at 8 (existing ♥10 friendship scenes, perks and Hearts.standing_with_you stay reachable for non-romancers); one partner at a time (G-rated, no jealousy group scene); any candidate for any hero body (same- and opposite-sex, no gender checks anywhere; text uses 'you' and the candidate's own pronouns from romance.json). Breaking up (stay_friends) is a gentle choice on the dating menu: no friendship loss, sets ex[id]=day, bouquet refused for 14 days with a kind line. No divorce for spouses in v1 (Tom to confirm). Romance is per save slot (GameState.save_key()).
needs_tom: Confirm: no divorce in v1; one partner at a time; no 8-heart cap.

Accepting stores run.romance.date = {id, n, day, scene, area, hours} and a QuestTracker/goal-line pin ('Meet <name> at the <spot> after 6pm'). Missed date: next morning a gentle line, no penalty except no date credit. dates[id] counts toward proposal (>=2). Gangster arc: same venues, text_gangsters lines (city-evening flavour, Rec Hall instead of Rec Center via Tickets.game_name/RecCenter names). Sky/time via GameState.sunset(), never fixed hours for 'sunset' wording.
